description: This PHP class provides a fluent interface for validating scalar member variables within a configuration schema for HTMLPurifier. It offers methods to assert types and characteristics such as being a string, boolean, array, not null, alphanumeric, non-empty, and lookup arrays, throwing exceptions upon validation failure.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_ValidatorAtom
classes.description: A class for validating individual configuration schema members, supporting type assertions and specific checks with a fluent interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with the context, object, and member name, establishing a reference to the member's value.

methods.name: assertIsString
methods.description: Asserts that the member's contents are a string.

methods.name: assertIsBool
methods.description: Asserts that the member's contents are a boolean.

methods.name: assertIsArray
methods.description: Asserts that the member's contents are an array.

methods.name: assertNotNull
methods.description: Ensures the member's contents are not null.

methods.name: assertAlnum
methods.description: Checks that the member's contents are a string of alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: assertNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks that the member's contents are not empty.

methods.name: assertIsLookup
methods.description: Verifies that the member's contents are an array of lookup values, specifically ensuring all elements are true.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Throws an exception with a message if validation fails.
